jobs.occupation: Air Freight Pricing Specialist (f/m/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung)
jobs.description: Welcome to Rhenus!The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of industry developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.What you can expect:- In this position, you will receive, review and process ad-hoc pricing requests from both the global network and own-controlled customers - including the clarification of customer requirements, if needed.- In addition, you will work closely with local operations and sales to understand customer needs, apply pricing according to local price sensitivity, and support the execution of margin and pricing strategies.- You will foster exchange with the Airfreight Pricing & Procurement Team (e.g., for shipment solutions over 1.5 tons) and the Gateway Team in Frankfurt to develop competitive and operationally feasible solutions.- Furthermore, you will ensure thorough documentation of all quotations and provide insightful reporting to local P&L responsible parties, local sales, the airfreight product team, and the Gateway.- Last but not least, you will be responsible for the follow-up on all provided spot quotations and related inquiries - ensuring feedback is received, success rates are monitored through standard reporting, and coordination with the Commercial Team is maintained. You will also follow customer-specific pricing instructions precisely.What you bring:- You have already gained previous experience in airfreight operations or sales, providing a solid foundation in industry processes and commercial dynamics.- A self-reliant working style combined with the ability to perform well under pressure in time-sensitive environments is one of your key strengths.- You have a confident and professional demeanor in negotiations and in communication with both customers and suppliers.- Naturally, you bring a strong numerical understanding and a sharp eye for detail, supporting accurate and data-driven decision-making.- Business fluency in English, along with strong verbal and written communication skills, round off your profile.Your benefits:- Cafeteria: Fuel your day with nutritious meals at our on-site cafeteria.- Continuous Training: Sharpen your skills and advance your expertise with our professional development programs.- Exclusive Discounts: Benefit from attractive employee discounts on different products and services.- Flexible Working Times: We offer flexible schedules to suit your lifestyle and personal commitments.- Free Parking: No one likes to start their day hunting for a spot - we've got guaranteed free parking spaces for everyone.- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.

jobs.employer_name: Forschungsgesellschaft für Arbeitsphysiologie u. Arbeitss chutz e. V.
jobs.description: ‘Forschungsgesellschaft für Arbeitsphysiologie und Arbeitsschutz e.V. Dortmund’ (legal entity name) is a research institution institutionally funded by the German Federal Ministry of Labor and Social Affairs and the State of North Rhine-Westphalia. It is the sponsor of ’Leibniz Research Centre for Working Environment and Human Factors in Dortmund’ (IfADo). IfADo explores the risks and potentials of modern work in interdisciplinary approaches. We combine the disciplines of Ergonomics, Immunology, Toxicology, Psychology and Neurosciences.The Department of Toxicology offers a Position asPhD candidate (f/m/d) (65 %) for a duration of 36 monthsProject description:Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is characterized by the accumulation of lipid droplets in the liver and represents a major cause of chronic liver disease in Western countries. MASLD can progress to steatohepatitis and, ultimately, to life-threatening end-stage diseases such as hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).A critical step in the progression from “benign” steatosis to steatohepatitis is bile macropinocytosis. This process leads to the vesicular regurgitation of concentrated bile from the bile canaliculi into hepatocytes, thereby promoting inflammation, cell death, and fibrosis. The aim of this project is to elucidate the mechanisms underlying the induction of bile macropinocytosis, determine its contribution to disease progression, and develop therapeutic strategies to inhibit bile macropinocytosis and ameliorate steatohepatitis.The project is part of a research program recently funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG). It involves in vivo experiments using mouse models of MASLD progression and the application of state-of-the-art techniques, including functional intravital imaging, immunohistochemistry, ELISA, and gene and protein expression analyses using real-time quantitative PCR and immunoblotting.Your Qualifications:- Master's degree or diploma/state examination in biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacy, toxico  logy, medicine, or a related field with an excellent final grade- Willingness to perform animal experiments and to learn microintervention techniques, including different routes of drug administration, microsurgery, and biological sample collection- Basic knowledge of molecular biology techniques- Ability to work independently and responsibly, but also as part of a team.- Interest in learning and establishing new techniques/technologies and presenting data at international conferences- Proficiency in spoken and written English- Aspiration to a research/academic careerYour tasks:- Preparation and characterization of mouse models to investigate MASLD progression, including therapeutic intervention experiments- Tissue and blood sample collection and processing- Histopathological and immunohistochemical analysis of liver tissue- Biochemical analysis of blood samples- Gene expression analysis- Data analysis and presentation of research findings at the department seminarsWe offer:- This is a part-time position with currently 25,89 working hours per week.- Remuneration according to the collective agreement for the public service of the federal states (position value EG 13 TV-L. The classification depends on the collective agreement and personal requirements), from EUR 3.093,59 to EUR 4.397,05 per month, depending on personal qualifications.- All the benefits of public sector (social) services, e.g., an annual bonus and capital-forming benefits- Flexible working time models to enable a good work-life balance- Excellent conditions for developing a scientific career, including in-depth knowledge in the fields of liver research and toxicology; well-equipped cell and molecular biology laboratories, confocal and two-photon-based microscopy, and a mouse facility with various reporter strains of liver cell types; Integration into an international network of leading scientists.IfADo is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our employees and welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of age, gender or gender identity, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and worldview, sexual orientation and identity, or disability.Applicants with severe disabilities will be given special consideration if they are equally qualified. We actively support the compatibility of work and family life and attach great importance to an equal and inclusive culture of cooperation.General information about the IfADo can be found at www.ifado.de.If you have any questions, please contact Prof. Ahmed Ghallab (ghallab@ifado.de)Interested?Then please send your meaningful application documents in a single PDF document and include:(CV, letter of motivation, copy of graduation certificates (university) and two references) including the reference code FB Toxi 06/26” until the 30.11.2026 preferably by mail to bewerbung@ifado.de.Dortmund, 04.11.2026(*We ask you to submit application documents only by E-mail. These will be destroyed by privacy after expiration of the retention period.)Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 40%

jobs.employer_name: Rheinland-Pfälzische Techn. Univers. Kaiserslautern-Landau Standort Landau
jobs.description: With about 15,000 students, more than 300 professorships and around 160 degree programs, the RPTU University Kaiserslautern-Landau is the technical university of the state of Rhineland-Palatinate. As a place of top international research, it offers excellent working conditions and career opportunities. Those who study, research or work at RPTU experience a cosmopolitan environment and shape the future.The Institute of Communication Psychology and Media Education (IKM) is looking for a PhD candidate. The position is assigned to the team of Prof. Dr. Michaela Maier. We are looking for a person with a clear scientific qualification goal.We offer integration into a dynamic, highly motivated working group, which provides both opportunities for collaboration and exchange as well as the freedom to develop your own ideas.Your area of responsibility:- The position’s main teaching focus is in environmental communication.- Teaching duties are based on the statutory provisions of the HLehrVO.Your requirements profile:- an excellent Bachelor's AND Master's degree in Communication Science- Interest in environmental communication is mandatory; interest in computational social sciences and journalism research is highly welcome.- Very good German, English and methodological skills are required; applicants should be able to teach in both German and English.- You enjoy working independently and have good organizational and communication skills.Weitere Informationen finden Sie auf unserer Homepage:https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/79896a746ef2fe490c2b36b38e6bd6781cea859f0 (https://jobs.rptu.de/jobposting/79896a746ef2fe490c2b36b38e6bd6781cea859f0)

Open mindedWe are a young, innovative university located in the heart of the Ruhr metropolis. We pride ourselves in outstanding research and teaching, think in terms of opportunities rather than limitations and develop ideas with a view to the future. Diversity is an integral part of our culture as we promote potential and are committed to upholding genuine equity in education.LocationDuisburgApplication areaFaculty of Chemistry, Technical ChemistryDoctoral Researcher, Technical Chemistry (f/m/x)EG 13 TV-L (gross 39.747–56.494 €)This position is part of the DFG-funded Collaborative Research Centre/Transregio 247 (CRC/TRR 247), “Het-erogeneous Oxidation Catalysis in the Liquid Phase”, which has secured its third funding period. The renewed funding underscores the sustained scientific development of this established interdisciplinary consortium.Within Project C05, “Doped Real and Model Transition Metal Oxide Catalysts from Pulsed Laser Defect Engi-neering in Liquid (PUDEL)”, you will use pulsed-lasers to modify cobalt spinel (Co3O4) nanoparticles and thin-film model catalysts. The research explores anion doping, laser-induced radical chemistry, and spatially con-trolled modification through Direct Laser Interference Patterning (DLIP). The aim is to relate processing parame-ters and defect chemistry to catalytic properties.The project is led by Prof. Dr. Stephan Barcikowski (https://www.uni-due.de/barcikowski-group/ (https://www.uni-due.de/barcikowski-group/) ), head of the technical chemistry I chair and carried out in the Catalysis Group of Dr. Benjamin Mockenhaupt (https://www.uni-due.de/chemie/mockenhaupt-group/index.php (https://www.uni-due.de/chemie/mockenhaupt-group/index.php) ) at the Duisburg campus, in close collaboration with CRC partners in catalysis, operando characterization, and theory.Start of employment2027-03-01Duration of employment2030-06-30Working time26 h 41 minutes (67 %)Your main tasks- You design and conduct pulsed-laser experiments on nanoparticles and thin films.- You investigate the isomorphous anion incorporation (e.g., F-, S2-, N3-) into metal oxides.- You explore laser-generated radicals and their influence on doping pathways.- You develop DLIP-assisted approaches for spatially controlled doping of thin-film model catalysts.- You characterize materials (e.g., UV–Vis, Raman/IR, XRD, XRF), coordinate advanced analyses with CRC partners, and relate findings to catalytic testing, operando studies, and modelling.- You plan and document reproducible experiments, share results within the consortium, and contribute to publications and conference presentations.You will be given the opportunity to pursue further academic qualification as part of this role.Your profile- above-average degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Physics, or a related discipline with a standard period of study of at least eight semesters degree- prior academic experience (e.g. skills in empirical research methods, laboratory procedures, experience with statistical analyses and relevant software/other applications) is required/desirable- scientific background in laser–material interactions, physical/materials or solid-state chemistry, surface science, or heterogeneous catalysis; experience in materials processing or characterization and data analysis.- independent, precise, and analytical working style; strong organizational skills and the ability to manage demanding experimental campaigns responsibly.- excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the motivation to share knowledge and coordinate research across disciplines and institutions.- willingness to learn new methods and concepts, develop scientific ideas, and contribute to advancing catalytic materials research; good English communication skillsWe offer you- job security in the public service with stable overall conditions and an area of responsibility that offers lots of variety in a research-focused environment with an international scope- an interesting, meaningful job with great potential to shape your role as you become familiar with the diverse tasks and developments in research transfer and cooperate with virtually all units within the University- an attractive work environment based on mutual appreciation and respect- the opportunity to pursue your doctoral qualification with numerous support options- a wide selection of further training and education opportunities- various canteens and cafés run by the Studierendenwerk on our campuses- attractive discounts through Corporate Benefits- a family-friendly University culture (e.g. care services for your children, advice on family care duties)- a sought-after location and an infrastructure featuring very good accessibility by public transport and free parking- flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home (depending on the position)- 30 days annual leave with a 5-day work week plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve- fair remuneration in accordance with collective agreements (TV-L), including an annual bonus and a supplementary pension scheme- numerous sports and health services (e.g. University sport)Application deadline2026-12-17Code number571-26ApplicationWe look forward to receiving your digital application including the usual documents (motivation letter, CV, attachments). Please specify the reference number and submit your application to Dr. Benjamin Mockenhaupt, Universität Duisburg-Essen, Faculty of Chemistry, 47057 Duisburg, phone +492033798116, email benjamin.mockenhaupt@uni-due.de (benjamin.mockenhaupt@uni-due.de) .Information about the jobhttp://www.uni-due.de/barcikowski-group/ (http://www.uni-due.de/barcikowski-group/%20https:/www.uni-due.de/chemie/mockenhaupt-group/index.php)https://www.uni-due.de/chemie/mockenhaupt-group/index.p (http://www.uni-due.de/barcikowski-group/%20https:/www.uni-due.de/chemie/mockenhaupt-group/index.php) hp (https://www.uni-due.de/chemie/mockenhaupt-group/index.php) Learn moreUniversity of Duisburg-Essen pursues the goal of promoting the diversity of its members.www.uni-due.de/diversity/en (https://www.uni-due.de/diversity/en)In accordance with the State Equal Opportunities Act, women with the same qualifications are given preferential consideration.Applications from suitable disabled persons and persons of equal status within the meaning of § 2 para. 3 SGB IX are desired.By applying for one of the advertised positions, you expressly agree to the requirements in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation and to being contacted by mail. Further information on data protection can be found here (https://www.uni-due.de/imperia/md/content/dokumente/2023/ude-datenschutz-bewerber-innen.pdf) .Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Nanotechnologie, Chemische Verfahrenstechnik, Physikalische Chemie

jobs.occupation: Barkhausen Institut gGmbH: Senior Engineer “Digital Hardware-Design” (m/w/d) (Embedded-Systems-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description: The Barkhausen Institut performs research on the latest hardware, software and communication technologies and demonstrates their application in tomorrow’s society. Our goal is to build a flexible and trustworthy IoT platform based on reliable electronics and secure communication methods.The group Scalable Computing Hardware is developing a secure and dependable multiprocessor system-on-chip (MPSoC) to establish a hardware platform for applications in the area of connected electronic systems.At the earliest possible date we are looking for aSenior Engineer “Digital Hardware Design” (m/w/d)The position will initially be filled for a period of 2 years and will be remunerated in line with TV-L E-13.Your responsibilities will include- Designing, developing and integrating digital hardware architectures for ASIC and FPGA designs- Independently defining, planning, and leading hardware architecture concepts- Implementing, simulating, and verifying digital hardware on RTL level using EDA software tools- Supporting FPGA prototyping and ASIC front-end design through to tape-out- Collaborating with backend teams to analyze and optimize RTL designs- Creating design and verification documentation- Setting up and managing Git flows and CI/CD pipelinesWe expect the following- Above-average M.Sc./Diploma degree in the field of electrical engineering/computer science or a comparable qualification- An integrative and cooperative personality with excellent communication and social skills- Very strong programming skills in Verilog/VHDL and Python- At least 5 years of professional experience in ASIC design, including working with modern EDA software tools (Cadence, Synopsys, open-source)- Very good communication and writing skills in English and German- Basic technical knowledge in the areas of processor systems and hardware securityYou are interested, but you don’t think you meet all the requirements of the job posting? Then you should know: We don’t hire resumes, we hire people. We are looking for potential and want to actively foster it. That’s why we encourage you to apply!What we provide- An open and creative team- Agile working hours and workflows- Cross-disciplinary projects- Work on future technologies- Flat hierarchies for your ideas and flexible teams- Our remuneration is based on the collective agreement for the federal states. If you meet all the professional requirements (diploma/master’s degree or doctorate), this position is classified as TV-L E 13. Depending on your professional experience, the basic monthly salary ranges between €4.759,37 and €6.764,69. We will be happy to provide more details during the interview.If you have passion for new technologies and the desire to develop the connected world of tomorrow with us, we are looking for you.Life and science are compatible at our institute. We offer a range of recognised family-friendly measures, such as part-time work, mobile working and flexible working hours that take family needs into account. We also offer support for arriving in Dresden (all formalities, apartment etc.).Application Procedure- Your application should include: CV, copy of university degree certificate- Barkhausen Institut strives for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability.- We only accept complete documents as one single PDF document by e-mail to Kontakt (über Bewerben-Kontaktformular) . Please reference ”Senior Engineer - Digital Hardware-Design” in the subject line. Applications that contain other file formats (e.g. Word, Excel) will not be considered in the selection process. Informal inquiries can also be submitted to the same address.The data submitted by you in the course of the application procedure will be processed by the Barkhausen Institut (BI). BI shall use the data for the purposes of the application procedure. No data shall be passed on to third parties.Schlagworte: BI, IoT, Internet of Things, designer, digital hardware architectures, eda-softwaretools, rtl-designs, frontend, Barkhausen Institut, python, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308199/senior-engineer-digital-hardware-design-m-strich-w-strich-d (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/308199/senior-engineer-digital-hardware-design-m-strich-w-strich-d#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenDas Barkhausen Institut ist ein international anerkanntes Forschungsinstitut, das die Brücke zwischen Grundlagenforschung und der praktischen Umsetzung der Vertrauenswürdigkeit vernetzter elektronischer Systeme schlägt.Wir erforschen innovative Informations- und Kommunikationstechnologien, um die Vertrauenswürdigkeit für eine vernetzte Welt zu ermöglichen. Unser Fokus liegt auf Eigenschaften wie Integrität, Zurechenbarkeit, Authentizität, Verfügbarkeit und Datenschutz.Neben unserer anwendungsorientierten Grundlagenforschung engagieren wir uns als Kooperationspartner und als Meinungsführer im Diskurs zum Thema Vertrauenswürdigkeit. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf eine professionelle Wissenschaftskommunikation und suchen den Dialog mit der Öffentlichkeit.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
